tbesh_html:
§ Ashtaroth or Astaroth = "star"
a city in Bashan east of the Jordan given to Manasseh

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan
strongs_1890.kjv_def: Asharoth, Astaroth. See also H1045 (בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת), H6253 (עַשְׁתֹּרֶת), H6255 (עַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם).
